LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.Title: Global adjustment (whole faction)
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.ModeRelative: Relative (shift every pair by an amount)
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.ModeAbsolute: Absolute (set every pair to a value)
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.RelativeTip: Relative mode adds the chosen amount to each pair's current compatibility. Positive improves, negative worsens. Can be applied repeatedly to stack.
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.AbsoluteTip: Absolute mode sets every pair's compatibility to exactly the chosen value, ignoring their current value.
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.ApplyTip: Add the slider amount to the current compatibility of every pair of colonists in your faction. Positive improves, negative worsens. Values are clamped to the configured min/max. This stacks with per-pair overrides and can be applied multiple times.
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.SliderTip: How much to shift every colonist pair's compatibility. 0 = no change.
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.Confirm: Shift the compatibility of all {0} colonist pairs by {1}?
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.Done: Shifted compatibility for {0} colonist pairs by {1}.
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.ApplyTipAbsolute: Set the compatibility of every pair of colonists in your faction to exactly the slider value. Clamped to the configured min/max. The base mod's per-pair Reset still restores the original value.
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.SliderTipAbsolute: The exact compatibility value every colonist pair will be set to.
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.ConfirmAbsolute: Set the compatibility of all {0} colonist pairs to {1}?
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.DoneAbsolute: Set compatibility of {0} colonist pairs to {1}.
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.LoadGameFirst: Load a game first - the compatibility store only exists in an active game.
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.AutoEnable: Continuously force every pair to the target value
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.AutoTip: In this save, while enabled, every colonist pair is continuously set to the target value (absolute). New colonists - recruits, births, freed prisoners - are caught automatically within a few seconds. Note: while Auto is on, manual per-pair edits are re-asserted on the next pass, so the in-dialog Apply is replaced with a notice.
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.AutoActiveNotice: Auto mode active - every colonist pair is being set to {0}. Disable Auto in the mod settings to edit manually.
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.NoStore: Pawn Compatibility Editor override store not found - cannot apply global adjustment.
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.NotEnough: Need at least two colonists to apply a global adjustment.
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.AutoDefaults: Auto mode: defaults for new games
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.AutoDefaultsTip: Only the starting values for new games. A save keeps its own Auto setting; changing this does not touch saves you already have.
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.AutoNoGame: Load a game to change Auto mode for that save.
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.ExemptEnable: Leave lovers, spouses, fiances and blood family alone
LanguageData.CompatibilityGlobal.ExemptTip: Pairs that are lovers, spouses, fiances or related by blood are skipped by Auto and by Apply. Pairs already changed stay as they are.
